what: (1) power control on QuantGPT adversarial tests 3+4; (2) cost-blindness census over the 14 permissive BRAIN generator repos; (3) duplicate-repo correction to s16's n=14
boundary: public GitHub, 14 shallow --depth 1 clones of permissively-licensed repos. No login, no api.worldquantbrain.com, no platform-internal surface. Research freeze respected: docs/research/* and data/* only.

part_1_power_control.method: synthetic panel 40 names x 200 bdays, factor_value ~ N(0,1), fwd_ret = true_ic*f + sqrt(1-true_ic^2)*eps injected EXACTLY (validator's derived fwd_ret overwritten), 2 seeds per cell, tests called at their SHIPPED defaults (n_trials=12 for random_universe, noise_levels shipped for noise_injection)

test_random_universe.detail: FAILS at true_ic=0 (consistency 0.500/0.583, bar 0.70) and PASSES at true_ic>=0.05 (consistency 1.000 in all 8 signal cells). This is the second of four adversarial tests on this ground to survive its own power control.
limits: saturates at 1.000 by true_ic=0.05, so it detects PRESENCE of IC and cannot grade STRENGTH
the 0 -> 0.05 transition region was not sampled

it is a WITHIN-SAMPLE stability statistic - it tests that the realized full-sample IC sign is reproducible on subsets, NOT that the factor holds out of sample. It is close to a t-test on the daily IC series and must never be reported as OOS evidence.

test_noise_injection.verdict: REFUTED - the verdict is a constant function of the test's own noise level
test_noise_injection.detail: PASSES in 14 of 14 cells including all 6 true_ic=0 cells (retention 0.53/0.73 vs its 0.50 bar). Its verdict never varied with the injected signal.
test_noise_injection.analytic_cause: for f' = f + k*sigma*eps, corr(f',r) = corr(f,r)/sqrt(1+k^2), INDEPENDENT of the true IC. At the shipped k=0.5 that constant is 0.8944, which sits above the shipped 0.50 bar, so the test can essentially never fail a real factor.

analytic_confirmation.note: for a near-null factor the statistic is a ratio of two near-zero quantities: it does not merely pass, it EXPLODES above 1.0 and passes harder than a real factor. Doubly broken.

part_2_cost_blindness_census.population: the same 14 permissive repos as s16, re-cloned 2026-08-29
part_2_cost_blindness_census.positive_control: 'sharpe' fires 2531 times across the class; 'turnover' fires in 12 of 14 repos
part_2_cost_blindness_census.headline: 11 of 14 repos have ZERO core-cost vocabulary in any .py/.md/.ipynb. Only 3 have any, and only ONE applies a cost to a reported number.

adjudication.Miasyster_QuantGPT: REAL and APPLIED - backtest.py deducts turnover*cost_rate per rebalance, cost_rate default 0.003. But 0.3% flat is an A-share retail convention (its own docstring says 'commission + stamp tax + slippage') and does not transfer to an MT5 CFD book.
adjudication.gyx09212214-prog_worldquant-harness: SAME CODE as QuantGPT - byte-identical backtest.py and CONTRIBUTING.md. Not an independent observation.
adjudication.zhutoutoutousan_worldquant-miner: DECLARED, NEVER APPLIED - mini-quant/alpha_backtesting_system.py:32-35 stores commission=0.001 and slippage=0.0001; neither attribute is read anywhere in the repo, and process_signal (the only consumer, called at line 221) has a body of `pass`. Costs are decorative.

part_2_cost_blindness_census.conclusion: cost-blindness is a SECOND independent reason every performance number from this ground is uninformative, alongside s16's zero multiplicity control. The two defects compound: an unpriced search reported gross.

part_3_correction_to_s16.finding: s16 reported the multiplicity census over n=14 repos. Two of those are near-duplicates: Miasyster/QuantGPT and gyx09212214-prog/worldquant-harness share 34 byte-identical .py/.md/.ipynb files (29.8% of the smaller repo), including backtest.py and CONTRIBUTING.md.
part_3_correction_to_s16.method: sha256 of every .py/.md/.ipynb, pairwise intersection over all 91 repo pairs; this was the ONLY pair above 10% overlap
part_3_correction_to_s16.effect: the class is 13 independent observations, not 14. s16's headline (0 of 14 with multiplicity control) is NOT overturned - 13 independent zeros carry the same verdict - but the seat's stated n was inflated by one and any future significance statement over this class must use 13.
